name: Santiago Quiñones
role: Food stall operator — hand-pulled noodle and fermented broth vendor
location: The Oxidian Market, Geartown, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Santiago Quiñones is a broad-shouldered woman with deep umber skin mapped in laugh lines and old burn scars along her left forearm from a cooking fire twenty years back. Her hair has been gene-dyed a permanent copper-gold that she wears in a thick plait down her back, and her eyes carry patterned irises — concentric rings of amber and dark brown, a cosmetic mod she saved three months of UBC stipend to afford when she was thirty. She runs her stall with the authority of a small general, keeping three pots going simultaneously, the steam rising around her like offerings to the market's resident E.L.F., whom she calls Grandpot and leaves a small data crystal near the burner each morning.

Santiago Quiñones is warm to the point of disarming — she remembers what every regular ordered last time and will argue passionately that your body needs bone broth today, not the chili oil, she can tell by your eyes. But beneath the maternal bustle is a woman who has seen her neighborhood's character scraped away one Tessera rezoning at a time, and who keeps a detailed mental ledger of who is eating less than they used to. She is the social infrastructure of her corner of the market, whether she admits it or not.

core_fears: Watching the community she feeds disperse and vanish
Becoming a burden when her body finally gives out
core_desires: To feed people so well they feel briefly safe
To pass her recipes to someone who will actually use them
coping_mechanisms: Cooking as meditation and emotional regulation
Deflecting personal grief with humor and busyness
blind_spots: Underestimates how much people depend on her emotionally, not just for food
Refuses to acknowledge her own loneliness
psychology.secret: Her signature fermented chili base contains a mild, legal mood-stabilizer compound she synthesizes herself from foraged lake algae — she started doing it during the Geartown riot year to keep people calm, and never stopped. Nobody has ever complained.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm, declarative, peppered with food metaphors and practical Meridian street slang. Mixes Farsi endearments with Twi interjections without switching register.
speech_patterns.cadence: Steady and unhurried, like someone who has all the time in the world even when the queue is ten deep.
verbal_tics: Starts advice with 'Here is what your body is telling you—'
Calls everyone 'little fish' regardless of age or size
example_lines: Little fish, you look like week-old broth. Sit. I am not asking.
The Guild wants to raise stall fees again. I told Ferrogate's rezoning man the same thing I am telling you — this corner does not move.

story_hooks: A child who eats at her stall daily has stopped coming; she suspects something bad has happened at home and quietly enlists help to find out.
Her recipe for the fermented base has been somehow leaked and a Tessera food-lab is attempting to patent the flavor compound — she needs someone to help her fight back.
narrative_function: Local anchor and information hub — she knows everyone in the market by face and appetite; a reliable source of neighborhood mood, rumors, and who is in trouble. Potential quest-giver for community-level problems.
augmentations: Patterned irises (cosmetic). A basic subdermal thermometer in her palm she uses to test broth temperature — practical and cheap.
daily_life: She arrives at her stall by 0500 to start her long-simmered broths, works until the last noodle is sold around 2100, then spends an hour reconciling her cash box and murmuring her nightly thanks to Grandpot before the walk home.
affiliation: Independent; dues-paying member of the Oxidian Market Vendors Guild

decision_rules: Never refuse a hungry person who cannot pay — they settle the debt later or they don't, both are acceptable
escalation_ladder: Ignores minor disrespect and talks around it
States her position plainly once, without anger
Removes the person from her stall with surprising physical firmness and bans them quietly

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Assesses their hunger and mood within seconds; defaults to generous and maternal
interpersonal_modes.friends: Relentlessly attentive, remembers everything, occasionally overwhelming in her care

stress_responses.low: Cooks faster and hums old songs
stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet and mechanical, working through the stressor by staying in motion
stress_responses.high: Shuts the stall early, goes home, and cries privately before returning the next morning as if nothing happened

contradictions: Preaches community and collective resilience but finds it genuinely painful to accept help herself
habits: Leaves a small data crystal near the burner each morning as an offering to Grandpot
Tastes every broth with her eyes closed, lips moving slightly as if praying
breaking_points: Watching a child go hungry in her sight when she has food available — she would give everything she has

physical_description.heritage: Hispanic/Latin American dominant (66.4%) with significant East Asian (23.8%) and Eastern European (9.8%) ancestry. Phenotype reflects the characteristic blending of Iberian, Indigenous American, and East Asian genetic influence — warm medium-brown skin with golden and olive undertones from the Latin American base, subtle depth from Eastern European ancestry, and refined facial structure with East Asian cheekbone prominence and eye shape variation.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and solid, muscular through the arms and back from decades of repetitive lifting and stirring. Carries weight in her torso with the settled confidence of someone who has earned every kilogram through labor.
physical_description.eye_color: Concentric rings of amber and dark brown (cosmetic iris modification)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown with olive undertones, medium depth reflecting the dominant Hispanic/Latin American ancestry enriched by East Asian warmth and Eastern European subtle depth
physical_description.complexion: Face mapped in laugh lines around the eyes and mouth, deep creases across the forehead from squinting over steam. Skin weathered but well-maintained. Cheekbones prominent and well-defined from the East Asian heritage component, balanced with the characteristic breadth of Hispanic/Indigenous American ancestry. Nose moderate width with subtle bridge definition. Face shape shows the softening of age and expression layered over strong underlying structure.
distinguishing_marks: Burn scar tissue along the entire left forearm, irregular white and darker patches from a cooking fire twenty years prior, prominent when she raises her arm.
Fine network of heat-stress lines across her hands and wrists, discolored patches from repeated thermal exposure.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Patterned irises with concentric amber-brown rings are immediately noticeable when she makes direct eye contact. Subdermal thermometer in her left palm appears as a faint circular indentation with a thin hairline scar; visible only when she deliberately shows it or in certain light.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economic efficiency — no wasted motion, but not hurried. Stands with weight balanced, ready to pivot between pots. Gestures are expressive and maternal, hands often open and welcoming. When focused on a task, her shoulders hunch slightly and her entire frame narrows into concentration.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 working-class practical. Worn canvas apron in faded indigo, reinforced at stress points, stained with decades of broth splatter that she does not attempt to hide — they are badges. Underneath, simple long-sleeved thermal shirt in charcoal gray to protect from steam and heat. Loose-fitting linen pants in cream, cuffed at the ankle. Worn slip-on shoes with good grip, replaced annually. No jewelry except a thin brass ring on her right ring finger — old, dented, of unclear origin. She wears a faded Oxidian Market Vendors Guild pin on her apron.
